title: What Shared Prefixes Hide: Trajectory Dropout for On-Policy Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2609.33455v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student model on its own trajectories using dense token-level feedback from a stronger teacher model. Since each update is conditioned on the reasoning prefix already generated by the student, the prefix also shapes how effectively teacher feedback is converted into learning. We find that shared prefixes can lead to weak token-level updates, a phenomenon we call Prefix-Induced Supervision Attenuation (PISA). This attenuation arises in two common cases. (i) High student confidence can weaken corrective gradients even when the teacher disagrees. (ii) Tokens that rely on earlier reasoning can receive learning signals as weak as those for simple local continuations. To solve this problem, we propose Trajectory Dropout, a simple training-time intervention that exposes these weakened signals. translated_title: 共享前缀所隐藏的：面向在线策略蒸馏的轨迹丢弃
translated_abstract: 在线策略蒸馏（OPD）利用更强教师模型提供的密集 token 级反馈，在学生模型自身生成的轨迹上对其进行训练。由于每次更新都以学生模型已生成的推理前缀为条件，该前缀也会影响教师反馈转化为学习效果的效率。我们发现共享前缀会导致 token 级更新变得微弱，我们将这一现象称为前缀诱导的监督衰减（PISA）。这种衰减出现在两种常见情形中：（i）即使教师模型持不同意见，学生模型的高置信度也会削弱纠正性梯度；（ii）依赖早期推理的 token 所获得的学习信号可能与简单局部续写所获得的信号一样微弱。为解决这一问题，我们提出轨迹丢弃，这是一种简单的训练时干预手段，能够暴露这些被削弱的信号。学生模型首先执行一次标准的全上下文滚动以生成完整轨迹。在训练过程中，[摘要在此处被截断]
tldr: 该论文发现在线策略蒸馏中共享前缀会引发监督衰减（PISA），导致教师反馈难以转化为有效学习信号，并提出轨迹丢弃这一训练时干预方法来暴露并恢复被削弱的学习信号。
